title: Litheli 18" Electric Self Propelled Lawn Mower (U20LM04-0A220, 2x 4.0Ah batteries)

comparisons.notes: Variant '2 x 4.0Ah with self-propelled', SKU U20LM04-0A220-UN-LI-US-001, same MPN as the Woot listing; product photo matches the Woot image. Compare-at price ignored.

writeup: Litheli's 18-inch brushless self-propelled cordless mower (model U20LM04-0A220) is $89.99 new on Woot, and this kit includes two 20V 4.0Ah batteries. Litheli's own store sells the same self-propelled two-battery version for $249.99, so Woot is about $160 less. Note the charger is not included, and Woot limits it to 3 per customer.
